newsitem.title: USA: Utilicorp backs 4-6 pct 1997 EPS growth.
newsitem.headline: Utilicorp backs 4-6 pct 1997 EPS growth.

text.p: UtiliCorp United Inc chief executive Richard Green told shareholders at the annual meeting Wednesday that the power utility is on track to achieve its goal of four- to six-percent earnings-per-share growth again in 1997, a goal it reached in 1996.

"Our 1997 first quarter results benefited from the robust performance of the Aquila Energy subsidiary as well as the increased contribution from international operations, particularly Australia," Green said.

Green said UtiliCorp's earnings outlook for the rest of 1997 anticipates continued strong contributions from Aquila and international businesses and the initial sales of new products and services that have been under development.
